@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+# is-svg [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/is-svg.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/is-svg)
+
+> Check if a String/Buffer is [SVG](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scalable_Vector_Graphics)
+
+
+## Install
+
+```sh
+$ npm install --save is-svg
+```
+
+```sh
+$ bower install --save is-svg
+```
+
+```sh
+$ component install sindresorhus/is-svg
+```
+
+
+## Usage
+
+```js
+isSvg('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path fill="#00CD9F"/></svg>');
+//=> true
+```
+
+
+## License
+
+MIT Â© [Sindre Sorhus](http://sindresorhus.com)

Make regex more strict

The existing regex matched any string with an occurrence of an <svg> tag
anywhere in the document.

By looking for a pair of tags and anchoring to the beginning and end of the
buffer, we can avoid a lot of false positives, including the README of this
module and the module's own source code.

Fixes #1.
